info.title: RecipePouch Edge API — Repository Replacement
info.description: Repository-scoped replacement contract assembled from implemented Edge Function handlers. It is not a parity reconstruction of the unavailable production OpenAPI v23. The route set is based on cook main bef764c4, including the merged admin and RevenueCat handlers. admin-ai is intentionally excluded because this repository has no implementation handler.
